Description

Scion that is both horse and woman, wielding utter control over the souls that wander the underworld, in opposition to the Martyr Igeyorhm, scion of light. Though she once served the gods as a guardian, when Ultima announced her rebellion, Shemhazai went to her, whispering of the gods' hidden weaknesses. She then descended upon the land without leave of the gods, and taught men of destruction and evil. For this was she stricken down and bound. - KenjiGoombah

description.value: Shemhazai, the Whisperer does not eat.
Shemhazai, the Whisperer does not sleep.

This Burst Mode lets Shemhazai imbues her power into her bolts. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Shemhazai can apply the Shock, Frost, or Flaming properties to her bolts, dealing 2d6 points of that element's damage, and can make an additional attack with each crossbow. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

effect: For five rounds, select one elemental property for the bolts and make one extra attack with each crossbow.

description.value: Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, Shemhazai creates 2d4 10 ft. explosions within 120 ft. away around the arena, dealing 4d10 points of fire damage to anyone caught in the explosions. A successful Reflex save (DC 27) halves the damage. Creatures hit with multiple explosions must make multiple Reflex saves.

effect: Place [[2d4]] explosions; roll a separate save for every overlap.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, Shemhazai uses her bolts to create a 15-ft. cloud of Disease around her. She can move through this cloud freely, and gains Concealment when attacking from a distance while in this cloud. Additionally, anyone caught within the cloud must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 27) or be given the Diseased status effect.

effect: Shemhazai moves freely in the cloud and gains concealment when attacking from range within it.

description.value: Shemhazai has the ability to use her dexterity to apply damage to each of her bolts. She can also apply her dexterity as an extra defense protecting herself gaining that as a deflection bonus.

This functions like Parry, except once every 1d3+1 rounds, Shemhazai can make an Acrobatics check. If successful, she hops back 15 ft. and can spend a Grit point to make a free attack with both crossbows.

effect: Parry with Acrobatics [[1d20 + @skills.acr.mod]]. On success hop back 15 ft.; spend one Grit for a free attack with both crossbows.

description.value: This functions like the Gunner's Grit ability. She has 9 points of Grit.

actions.name: Whisper in the Wind: return fire

effect: After successful parry only. One attack per crossbow for one Grit.

description.value: Use the burst crossbow routines. Select exactly one of Shock, Frost, or Flaming.
